payload.title: Close E004 deployment gate without leaderboard submission
payload.decision: Mark E004 deployment-ready after exact private Kaggle parity, retain geometry-prefix as a deterministic fallback and candidate-bank leg, and do not spend a leaderboard submission on its isolated 0.4185-RMSE CV gain.
payload.rationale: The notebook is operationally valid and byte-stable across local Python and Kaggle Python 3.12, but the gain is small and prior evidence shows CV/leaderboard ordering can invert.
payload.revisit_trigger: A stronger test-available candidate or controlled blend proves that E004 adds no fallback or diversity value, or a future Kaggle runtime invalidates the portable inference contract.
